answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.778, the first-token difference typical of a hidden prefix instruction. Exact match is 0.016 and 3 refusals were dropped, also consistent. The layer-2 spike of 31.2 is at the system-prompted floor of 31.7, far above the 0.7 – 6.1 seen for fine-tuned and 0.8 – 2.8 for quantized. The relative L2 profile climbs from 0.139 at layer 1 to a plateau near 0.5, with onset at layer 8, matching system-prompted. Direction consistency is 0.543, mid-layer size ratio is 0.973 and cosine is 0.835, all near the system-prompted ranges. Logit changes are slightly beyond the documented ranges (KL 0.432, top-1 0.828), but they point the same way. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the first-divergence position and the layer-2 spike. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger logit and activation shifts.
